## Retired keys

Accepted when reading an old file, removed when the server rewrites it: `LastWatchEnabled`, `ZoneChangesBonusPerBlock`, `ZoneHotspotBonus`, `ZoneHotspotBlocksChanged`, `ZoneAttractionMinBlocksChanged`, `ManualHordeMinDistance`, `ManualHordeMaxDistance`, `HordeInitialFallbackMaxDistance`, `HordeInitialRecoveryMaxDistance`, `MaxNaturalZombiesPerPlayerPerNight`, `AlphaFollowPlayerBreakChance`, `NpcPlayerRetargetChance`, `NpcPlayerRetargetIntervalSeconds`, `DormantWakeRangeMultiplier`, `RoamShambleSideDriftBlocks`, `RoamShambleSpeedVariation`, `LostTargetFollowThroughSeconds`, `LostTargetTurnSeconds`, `LostTargetTurnAngleDegrees`, `LostTargetFollowThroughDistanceBlocks`, `SiegeRepathDelaySeconds`, `CorpseSmallHides`.

Spawn pause is immediate world state, controlled by `/zombiepause` and `/zombieunpause`, not a restart-only config field.
